# MinGW-w64 runtime notices

These unchanged upstream license/copyright texts were copied from the
`aarch64-w64-mingw32/share/mingw32` directory of the pinned LLVM-MinGW
20261006 distribution. They cover the MinGW-w64 runtime and winpthreads.
They are a fallback for runtime distributions that omit installed license
texts, including the local WinLibs toolchain. Runtime/toolchain license texts
present in a selected distribution are also collected when available.

Source: https://github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw/releases/tag/20261006
